next.reason: 1985: a BY CONTENT value is 'placed into a system-defined storage item possessing the attributes declared in the Linkage Section', and each BY CONTENT parameter's description 'must be the same, meaning no conversion or extension or truncation'. §2023:14.2.3 GR9: for a plain CALL the allocated record 'is of the same length as the argument' and 'moved to this allocated record without conversion'; for a prototyped or NESTED call it has the formal parameter's description and is filled by COMPUTE, SET or MOVE. Conformance is looser: §2023:14.8.2.3.3 asks only that 'the formal parameter shall be of the same length as the corresponding argument' for an elementary item in a plain CALL (MOVE/COMPUTE rules otherwise), and §2023:14.8.2.2 SR2 applies MOVE rules to a group. §2023:13.7.3 SR3 and §2023:14.9.4.3 SR25 bind both sides to these rules, and §2023:14.9.4.4 GR3d makes a detected violation set EC-PROGRAM-ARG-MISMATCH (1985 stated only the requirement).
